messages:
maria (eng-security): FYI we just got a DSAR for an EU user. Legal is asking for full deletion, but we have GCP snapshots + nightly backups encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key. Also a low-severity vuln report landed that MAY have exposed internal IDs. need quick plan :eyes:
ashwin (eng-ml): do we know which artifacts contain PII? my worry is embeddings and search indexes + the DB rows. backups obviously include all of that.
olga (eng-sre): snapshots/backups are encrypted at-rest with the CMK. We can rotate or destroy key versions to render old snapshots unreadable, but that is irreversible and legal may block. Also, we need a temporary RBAC path for an erasure runner to update live DBs and annotate logs.
jamie (legal): Important: if there's an active incident/vuln triage that could be litigation-related, we may need to preserve evidence until counsel signs off. DSAR requires deletion "to the extent possible" — we can do live deletion + log the justification for retained backups. Will verify asap with counsel.
ashwin (eng-ml): For embeddings: we can reingest sanitized placeholders (e.g., hash-sample or zero vector) for the user's vectors and mark as deleted in metadata. That handles live stores, but not snapshots.
maria (eng-security): Proposal: 1) snapshot evidence export: export relevant audit logs + index slices for forensics into a locked bucket (restricted access) 2) request temporary RBAC for `erasure-runner@project` with narrowly scoped roles to scrub live systems 3) if counsel approves, perform CMK key rotation strategy to make backups unreadable 4) keep an auditable justification document in the compliance bucket.
olga (eng-sre): I can spin up the temporary service acct flow. Suggested minimal roles: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter (limited to key ring), roles/datastore.viewer, roles/storage.admin (only for the evidence export bucket). We'll gate with a short TTL and record the grant in audit. We should also enable an explicit policy_change audit log for that grant.
jamie (legal): Sounds reasonable. I need to confirm hold/no-hold within 4 hours. If hold is required, we can't rotate/destroy keys but we can still sanitize live indexes and produce the evidence export.
ashwin (eng-ml): Sanitize script outline (will produce a PR):
```
# pseudocode
find user vectors -> replace with ZERO_VECTOR or HMAC(user_id) placeholder
update metadata: deleted=true, deleted_at=now
append audit entry to compliance log
```
I'll add snapshot identifiers to the audit so we can show what we couldn't alter.
maria (eng-security): Also: add an audit flag for any RBAC grant named `erasure-temp-grant` and retain admin logs for 7 years for compliance. ops: make sure KMS admin ops are logged.
sre-bot: Auto: snapshot-exports job queued -> export job id j-5771 (will post status).
olga (eng-sre): Action items assigned: 1) olga create temp SA + request template for roles (will post `gcloud` command) 2) ashwin produce sanitize PR + run on staging 3) maria prepare audit log entry and retention ticket 4) jamie confirm legal hold/no-hold. Target: EOD.
maria (eng-security): Quick gcloud example I'll use in the ticket (olga please sanity-check):
```
# create SA
gcloud iam service-accounts create erasure-runner --display-name="Erasure Runner"
# grant limited KMS decrypt (scoped)
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key --member=serviceAccount:erasure-runner@PROJ.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
# grant storage access for evidence export
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJ --member=serviceAccount:erasure-runner@PROJ.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectAdmin
```
olga (eng-sre): that looks fine, but we'll use least-privilege on the key resource (not project-wide). I'll post the exact scoped commands in ~10m and set TTL via iam binding script.
jamie (legal): thanks. if counsel says hold=false, legal will authorize key rotation steps with explicit signed memo.
maria (eng-security): ok everyone, i'll open the compliance ticket and assign. please add short notes to the ticket as you act so the audit trail is complete. :thumbsup:
nashwin (eng-ml): +1
olga (eng-sre): +1
jamie (legal): +1
(devops-bot): Reminder: please tag incidents with #dsar and add case number once created."
